snippet.title: Breathedge 2 - Official Character Trailer - The Mechanic - FGS Live From gamescom latam
snippet.description:
Warning! This new trailer that debuted in FGS Live From gamescom latam contains a song so hideously catchy you can never unhear it. The original Breathedge was a cult classic infamous for its relentless, contentious, gags and humor. Breathedge 2 is a new space survival game where you need to look after the chicken, and defeat an evil space corporation. This new trailer introduces us to the character of the Mechanic, a foul-mouthed customisable robot with a cardboard moustache, who fixes up your cars. Breathedge 2 is coming to PC / Steam. 

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS #gamescomlatam
